# Third-party assets

All other models, textures and sounds in ONE ROAD DOWN are generated by the project's own
scripts (tools/blender/*.py, src/gfx/textures.js, src/audio/audio.js).

From [KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Assets](https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Assets):

| File | Asset | Licence / authors |
| --- | --- | --- |
| assets/models/fox.glb | Fox | Model: PixelMannen, CC0 1.0 · Rigging & animation: tomkranis, CC-BY 4.0 · glTF conversion: @AsoboStudio and @scurest, CC-BY 4.0 |
| assets/models/props3p.glb | CommercialRefrigerator | Eric Chadwick / Darmstadt Graphics Group, CC-BY 4.0; based on "Commercial Fridge" by Sean Thomas, CC-BY 4.0 (bottles decimated, textures reduced) |
| assets/models/props3p.glb | AnisotropyBarnLamp | Eric Chadwick / Wayfair LLC, CC-BY 4.0 (textures reduced) |

From [mrdoob/three.js](https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js) (MIT): vendor/three.module.min.js,
vendor/GLTFLoader.js, vendor/BufferGeometryUtils.js, vendor/SkeletonUtils.js.
